gloss: photogenic quality; how well something photographs

definitions.gloss: photogenic quality; how good something looks in photos or on screen
definitions.explanation: The quality of looking good or impressive when photographed or filmed. Describes how well a subject's appearance translates to photographs, video, or television.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}して→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}けた→盛り付ける：14764_moritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I plated the food with photogenic appeal in mind.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧{写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{写|うつ}り→写り：20375_utsuri⟧ (how something appears in a photo/on screen) and {映|は}え (shining, looking impressive — the same {映|は}え as in the popular word ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧). The reading changes to ばえ through rendaku.

This word predates the social media era but has gained renewed relevance with Instagram culture. While ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧ specifically refers to looking good on Instagram, {写|うつ}り{映|ば}え is a more general term for photogenic quality that applies to any photography or filming context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to be photogenic; to look good in photos
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be visually striking in photos
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧: to care about how one looks in photos
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧: to be conscious of photogenic appeal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧: Instagrammable — specifically for social media
- ⟦{見|み}{栄|ば}え→見栄え：09044_mibae⟧: visual appearance; outward show — how something looks in general, not limited to photos
- ⟦{写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}→写り具合：29814_utsuriguai⟧: how something comes out in a photo — more neutral, describing the result rather than the appeal
